sources.label: Your apps. Your rules. Open-source Morphe patches for Android: less clutter, mor
sources.author: Loki
patch_list: Lets you take screenshots and record the screen everywhere in IMO, including chat media, profile photos, calls and protected chats.
Shows the Apps option in the chat attachment menu so you can send an installed app as a file.
Lets you record and post a story while a call is going on. IMO blocks it by default.
Turns on IMO's own disappearing-message option when you send in private and group chats. IMO's servers decide whether the other person gets it.
Removes the row of emojis above the chat box in IMO, where one tap sends the emoji straight away.
Removes the paid Premium Member entry from the Me page.
Removes the voice rooms tab (Room and Explore) from the top bar of IMO, so only Chats and Contacts are left.
Removes the ads in IMO: the opening ad, ads in chats, stories and after a call, and the offer to pay to go ad-free.
Makes IMO believe it is still the original app after patching, so the phone verification code is sent again and push notifications keep working. Without it the app runs but never receives an SMS.
